standard_prerequisites.name: A quasi-affine scheme is quasi-compact and identifies with an open subscheme of the spectrum of its ring of global functions, and the open sets where a global function is invertible and the corresponding localized ring is the ring of sections form a basis when they are affine
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the finite cover by standard affine opens used to build the immersion.

standard_prerequisites.name: The same-chapter characterization of locally finite type morphisms by finite type ring maps on affine charts
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes each coordinate ring of a chart a finite type algebra over the coordinate ring of an affine open of the base.

standard_prerequisites.name: The construction of a morphism into an affine space over the base from global sections of the structure sheaf and the identification of preimages of standard opens
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces the candidate morphism and identifies the preimage of the standard open cut out by the j-th coordinate with the j-th chart.

core_obligations: Set up the cover: let the ring of global functions be A; by quasi-affineness the scheme is quasi-compact and an open subscheme of the spectrum of A, and the standard affine opens form a basis, so choose finitely many functions whose standard opens cover the scheme with each lying above an affine open of the base (proof lines 9380-9392).

Make the coordinate rings finitely generated: by the locally finite type characterization each coordinate ring is a finite type algebra over the corresponding base ring, so choose finitely many global functions which, together with the inverse of the chart function, generate that coordinate ring over the base ring (proof lines 9389-9393).

Build the morphism: take the number of coordinates to be the number of chart functions plus the number of chosen generators and define the morphism into affine space over the base by that list of global sections; the preimage of the standard open where the j-th coordinate is invertible is the j-th chart, and the induced morphism from that chart factors through an affine open of the standard open (proof lines 9394-9403).

Conclude immersiveness: the ring map from that affine open to the coordinate ring of the chart is surjective by the choice of generators, so the restriction of the morphism to each preimage is an immersion, and hence the morphism itself is an immersion (proof lines 9404-9410).
proof_roadmap: Cover the quasi-affine source by finitely many standard affine opens over affine opens of the base and express generators of their coordinate rings through global functions (proof lines 9380-9393).

Use that list of global functions as coordinates of a morphism into an affine space over the base and check on each standard open that the restriction is an immersion, hence the morphism is one (proof lines 9394-9410).
difficulty_reason: The lemma says that a quasi-affine scheme which is locally of finite type over a base admits an immersion into an affine space over that base (statement lines 9372-9378). The counted proof is a concrete construction: it uses quasi-affineness to cover the scheme by finitely many standard affine opens lying over affine opens of the base, converts the finite type hypothesis on the charts into finitely many generators of their coordinate rings expressed through global functions, builds the morphism into an affine space over the base from that list of global functions, identifies the preimages of the standard opens with the charts, and checks the induced ring maps are surjective so that the restrictions are immersions (proof lines 9380-9410). It is H2: the cover, the construction and the verification are all carried out in the counted span, with the cited inputs being the quasi-affineness and locally finite type characterizations.
